user.title: Just-In-Time Freebox
user.description: Configure the grants API and your local Freebox server. After submitting, you will be asked to press the right arrow on the Freebox front panel to authorize this integration.

pairing.title: Authorize on Freebox
pairing.description: Press the right arrow (▶) on the Freebox front panel within 60 seconds to authorize Home Assistant.

error.grants_api_error: Could not reach the grants API with the provided URL/key.
error.freebox_discovery_error: Could not discover the Freebox API at this host. Check host and HTTPS setting.
error.freebox_auth_error: Could not start authorization on the Freebox.
error.pairing_pending: Pairing did not complete in time. Try again and press the front-panel button.
error.pairing_denied: Pairing was denied on the Freebox.
error.pairing_timeout: Pairing timed out on the Freebox.
